1.t: Verily, We have sent it (this Qur’ân) down in the night of Al-Qadr (Decree).

1.fn:
"Therein (that night) is decreed every matter of ordainments." [The Qur’ân, (Verse 44:4)]**

** i.e., the matters of deaths, births, provisions, calamities for the whole (coming) year as decreed by Allâh.

2.t: And what will make you know what the night of Al-Qadr (Decree) is?

3.t: The night of Al-Qadr (Decree) is better than a thousand months (i.e. worshipping Allâh in that night is better than worshipping Him a thousand months, i.e. 83 years and 4 months).

4.t: Therein descend the angels and the Rûh [Jibrîl (Gabrîl)] by Allâh’s Permission with all Decrees,

5.t: (All that night), there is Peace (and Goodness from Allâh to His believing slaves) until the appearance of dawn.

5.fn: Narrated ‘Âishah رضي الله عنها: Allâh’s Messenger صلى الله عليه وسلم said, "Search for the Night of Qadr in the odd nights of the last ten nights of Ramadan." (Sahih Al-Bukhari, Vol. 3, Hadith No.234).
